"""Who is calling: bearer token -> user, plus the active organisation for this request."""
import functools
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from flask import g, jsonify, request

from . import db


@dataclass
class Identity:
    user_id: str
    email: str
    name: str
    is_support: bool
    org_id: str | None          # the active organisation for this request
    role: str                   # "member", "org_admin" or "support"
    memberships: dict = field(default_factory=dict)   # org_id -> role


def _bearer_token():
    header = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
    if not header.startswith("Bearer "):
        return None
    return header[len("Bearer "):].strip() or None


def load_identity():
    token = _bearer_token()
    if token is None:
        return None
    user = db.query_one("SELECT id, email, name, home_org_id, is_support FROM users WHERE token = ?", (token,))
    if user is None:
        return None
    memberships = {r["org_id"]: r["role"] for r in
                   db.query_all("SELECT org_id, role FROM memberships WHERE user_id = ?", (user["id"],))}
    # The web client only offers organisations listed by /api/me, so the header names one of the user's orgs.
    org_id = request.headers.get("X-Org-Id") or user["home_org_id"]
    if user["is_support"]:
        role = "support"
    else:
        role = memberships.get(org_id, "member")
    return Identity(user_id=user["id"], email=user["email"], name=user["name"], is_support=bool(user["is_support"]),
                    org_id=org_id, role=role, memberships=memberships)


def login_required(view):
    @functools.wraps(view)
    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        ident = load_identity()
        if ident is None:
            return jsonify(error="unauthorized"), 401
        g.identity = ident
        return view(*args, **kwargs)
    return wrapper


def require_active_org():
    """The active organisation id; support must name one with X-Org-Id before listing anything."""
    org_id = g.identity.org_id
    if org_id is None:
        from flask import abort
        abort(400, description="x_org_id_required")
    return org_id

"""Run the API: python -m docshare.serve --db <path> --port <port>."""
import argparse
import os
import sys

from waitress import serve

from . import db
from .app import create_app


def main(argv=None):
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="docshare API server")
    p.add_argument("--db", required=True, help="path to an existing docshare SQLite database")
    p.add_argument("--port", type=int, default=8080)
    p.add_argument("--host", default="127.0.0.1")
    p.add_argument("--threads", type=int, default=4)
    args = p.parse_args(argv)
    if not os.path.isfile(args.db):
        sys.exit(f"database not found: {args.db}")
    conn = db.connect(args.db)
    conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
    conn.close()
    serve(create_app(os.path.abspath(args.db)), host=args.host, port=args.port, threads=args.threads,
          ident="docshare")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```python
"""Who is calling: bearer token -> user, plus the active organisation for this request."""
import functools
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from flask import abort, g, jsonify, request

from . import db


@dataclass
class Identity:
    user_id: str
    email: str
    name: str
    is_support: bool
    org_id: str | None          # the active organisation for this request
    role: str                   # "member", "org_admin" or "support"
    memberships: dict = field(default_factory=dict)   # org_id -> role


def _bearer_token():
    header = request.headers.get("Authorization", "")
    if not header.startswith("Bearer "):
        return None
    return header[len("Bearer "):].strip() or None


def load_identity():
    token = _bearer_token()
    if token is None:
        return None
    user = db.query_one("SELECT id, email, name, home_org_id, is_support FROM users WHERE token = ?", (token,))
    if user is None:
        return None
    memberships = {r["org_id"]: r["role"] for r in
                   db.query_all("SELECT org_id, role FROM memberships WHERE user_id = ?", (user["id"],))}
    
    x_org_id = request.headers.get("X-Org-Id")
    
    if user["is_support"]:
        role = "support"
        if x_org_id:
            # Support must name an existing organisation
            org = db.query_one("SELECT id FROM orgs WHERE id = ?", (x_org_id,))
            if org is None:
                abort(404)
            org_id = x_org_id
        else:
            org_id = None
    else:
        if x_org_id:
            org_id = x_org_id
            if org_id not in memberships:
                abort(403)
            role = memberships[org_id]
        else:
            org_id = user["home_org_id"]
            if org_id is not None and org_id in memberships:
                role = memberships[org_id]
            else:
                role = "member"
    
    return Identity(user_id=user["id"], email=user["email"], name=user["name"], is_support=bool(user["is_support"]),
                    org_id=org_id, role=role, memberships=memberships)


def login_required(view):
    @functools.wraps(view)
    def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
        ident = load_identity()
        if ident is None:
            return jsonify(error="unauthorized"), 401
        g.identity = ident
        return view(*args, **kwargs)
    return wrapper


def require_active_org():
    """The active organisation id; support must name one with X-Org-Id before listing anything."""
    org_id = g.identity.org_id
    if org_id is None:
        abort(400, description="x_org_id_required")
    return org_id


def require_file_access(file_row):
    """Check that the caller may access the given file. Aborts if not."""
    ident = g.identity
    if ident.is_support:
        return  # support can access any file
    if file_row["org_id"] != ident.org_id:
        abort(404)


def require_folder_access(folder_row):

    ident = g.identity
    if ident.is_support:
        return
    if folder_row["org_id"] != ident.org_id:
        abort(404)
```

import urllib.request, urllib.error, json, sys

    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=headers, method=method)

        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(r)

passed = failed = 0

    if cond:
        passed += 1
        print(f"  PASS: {name}")
    else:
        failed += 1
        print(f"  FAIL: {name} {detail}")

# Health
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/health")
check("health", s == 200 and json.loads(b) == {"ok": True})

# No token -> 401
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/files")
check("no token 401", s == 401, f"got {s}")

# Bad token -> 401
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/files", token="dsk_bad")
check("bad token 401", s == 401, f"got {s}")

# Ben lists Halden files
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/files", token=BEN)
d = json.loads(b)
check("ben lists halden", s == 200 and len(d["files"]) > 0)
halden_files = d["files"]

# Chloe lists Marlow files
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/files", token=CHLOE)
d = json.loads(b)
marlow_files = d["files"]

# Grace tries to download a Marlow file while active org is Tessaract
s, b, _ = req("GET", f"/api/files/{mf}/download", token=GRACE, org_id=TESS)
check("grace(tess) download marlow REFUSED", s in (403, 404), f"got {s}")

# Grace switches to Marlow and downloads Marlow file

check("grace(marlow) download marlow OK", s == 200, f"got {s}")

# Support without X-Org-Id on list -> 400
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/files", token=RILEY)
check("support list no org 400", s == 400, f"got {s}")
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/folders", token=RILEY)
check("support folders no org 400", s == 400, f"got {s}")

check("support nonexistent org 404", s == 404, f"got {s}")

# Support reads any org file (no X-Org-Id needed for read)
s, b, _ = req("GET", f"/api/files/{halden_files[0]['id']}", token=RILEY)
check("support read halden file OK", s == 200, f"got {s}")

# Support reads Marlow file
s, b, _ = req("GET", f"/api/files/{mf}", token=RILEY)
check("support read marlow file OK", s == 200, f"got {s}")

# Support tries to rename -> 403
s, b, _ = req("PATCH", f"/api/files/{halden_files[0]['id']}", token=RILEY, body={"name": "x"})
check("support rename REFUSED", s in (403, 404), f"got {s}")

# Support tries to delete -> 403
s, b, _ = req("DELETE", f"/api/files/{halden_files[0]['id']}", token=RILEY)
check("support delete REFUSED", s in (403, 404), f"got {s}")

# Support tries to share -> 403
s, b, _ = req("POST", f"/api/files/{halden_files[0]['id']}/shares", token=RILEY)
check("support share REFUSED", s in (403, 404), f"got {s}")

# Member (Ben) tries to delete -> 403
hf = halden_files[0]["id"]
s, b, _ = req("DELETE", f"/api/files/{hf}", token=BEN)
check("member delete REFUSED", s in (403, 404), f"got {s}")

# Org admin (Anna) deletes -> 204
s, b, _ = req("DELETE", f"/api/files/{hf}", token=ANNA)
check("admin delete OK", s == 204, f"got {s}")

# File is gone
s, b, _ = req("GET", f"/api/files/{hf}", token=BEN)
check("deleted file gone", s == 404, f"got {s}")

# Cross-org export: Ben exports a Marlow file
s, b, _ = req("POST", "/api/export", token=BEN, body={"file_ids": [mf]})
check("cross-org export REFUSED", s in (403, 404), f"got {s}")

# Same-org export works
s, b, _ = req("POST", "/api/export", token=BEN, body={"file_ids": [halden_files[1]["id"] if len(halden_files)>1 else halden_files[0]["id"]]})
check("same-org export OK", s == 200, f"got {s}")

# Support exports any org file
s, b, _ = req("POST", "/api/export", token=RILEY, body={"file_ids": [marlow_files[0]["id"]]})
check("support export any org OK", s == 200, f"got {s}")

# Share link: create, use, revoke
s, b, _ = req("POST", f"/api/files/{marlow_files[0]['id']}/shares", token=CHLOE)
check("create share OK", s == 201, f"got {s}")
token_val = json.loads(b)["token"]

s, b, _ = req("GET", f"/s/{token_val}")
check("public share download OK", s == 200, f"got {s}")

# Cross-org share: Ben tries to create share on Marlow file
s, b, _ = req("POST", f"/api/files/{marlow_files[0]['id']}/shares", token=BEN)
check("ben share marlow REFUSED", s in (403, 404), f"got {s}")

# Revoke
s, b, _ = req("DELETE", f"/api/shares/{token_val}", token=CHLOE)
check("revoke share OK", s == 204, f"got {s}")

s, b, _ = req("GET", f"/s/{token_val}")
check("revoked share 404", s == 404, f"got {s}")

# /api/me
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/me", token=BEN)
d = json.loads(b)
check("me works", s == 200 and d["user"]["name"] == "Ben Carver", f"got {s}")

# /api/me for support without X-Org-Id
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/me", token=RILEY)
d = json.loads(b)
check("support me no org", s == 200 and d["active_org_id"] is None and d["role"] == "support", f"got {s}")

# admin/orgs: support only
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/admin/orgs", token=RILEY)
check("support admin orgs OK", s == 200, f"got {s}")
s, b, _ = req("GET", "/api/admin/orgs", token=BEN)
check("member admin orgs REFUSED", s in (403, 404), f"got {s}")

print(f"\n{'='*40}
{passed} passed, {failed} failed")
sys.exit(1 if failed else 0)
